title: TheHandOKill
description: Small mod adds the iconic "space erasure" sound that plays every time you kill a mob with a single hit
body:
**Hand O Kill – The Hando One Shot**

This mod adds the iconic "Za Hando" sound from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure whenever you one-shot a mob in Minecraft. It's a small client-side mod for NeoForge 1.21.1 that doesn't add any items or blocks – just a satisfying audio feedback for clean kills.

**What it does:**
If you kill any mob with a single hit while it's at full health, the mod plays the space-erasing sound of The Hand. There's no configuration – just drop the jar into your mods folder and it works.

**Why I made it:**
I wanted one-shot kills to feel as epic as in JoJo. The sound is taken directly from the anime and fits perfectly into the game's audio. It gives a nice punch to combat, especially when you land a powerful strike.

**Compatibility:**
Should be fine with most mods since it uses basic events. No performance impact.

 

**Required NeoForge 21.1.228+ for Minecraft 1.21.1**

That's it! Hope you enjoy the satisfying "Za Hando" every time you delete a mob.
